title: Lakebase backup schedule API (Beta)
body: You can now manage Lakebase backup schedules programmatically. The snapshot schedule API lets you read and set a root branch's automated snapshot cadences (daily, weekly, or monthly) and how long each cadence's snapshots are retained. This API is in Beta and available to all Lakebase workspaces. See [Create a backup schedule](/aws/en/oltp/projects/snapshots#snapshot-schedules).
